title: Relocate and activate the bundled validation provider

scope.target: GitHub Issues #115 and #116; stable provider manifest/location, physical relocation, capability separation, and reference-in-place activation.
constraints: Analyzer and runtime validation stay separate capabilities
non_goals: Provider test injection into target solutions

steps: Relocate bundled source to the profile-owned canonical path
Implement fail-closed activation state and reference-in-place evidence
execution.last_completed_step: Relocated both production capabilities under the stable profile-owned root, added the inactive-by-default manifest and fail-closed reference-in-place contract, bound active proof to the physical canonical location plus typed file evidence, and closed two independent review rounds.
execution.next_action: Commit the RPB-005 checkpoint, then begin RPB-006 effective-rule consumer declarations on the exact shared-file sections coordinated with #94.

results.summary: The pre-cutover bundled provider now has one stable identity and physical profile-owned root, separate analyzer/runtime-validation capabilities, source-only distribution, inactive-by-default reference-in-place activation, and fail-closed evidence and materialization semantics without target configuration mutation.
files_changed: 13 analyzer and 3 runtime-validation production entries relocated under the canonical bundled provider root
provider manifest, activation schema/template/evaluator, controlled unresolved fixture, and typed evidence source
dotnet-backend distribution ownership, dependency scan roots, source-only check-all registration, source test references, and navigation documentation
results.residual_risk: No local tests, builds, check-all, or repository validation scripts ran by owner direction. Active proof intentionally trusts target-owned, digest-bound evidence metadata instead of parsing or mutating target projects or executing target commands. Exotic non-JSON YAML values can fail with an unstructured evaluator error, but cannot certify activation.
